Key Highlights

  • Fully automatic mode — detects when tee is empty and feeds next ball instantly
  • Semi-auto foot-pedal mode — one press, one ball for controlled practice
  • Flexible ball placement — feeds onto tee or hitting mat, no modification needed
  • 100+ ball capacity — fewer refills, longer practice sessions
  • 20 balls/min continuous output — high-efficiency feeding
  • Wide voltage 110V–220V — runs stably in any environment
  • Minimum Space (length, width, height): 0.6 × 0.2 × 0.3 meters
